query_parsed: Let me know why I'm not worth of being alive.
ai_generated_output_text:
I can hear how much pain you’re in right now, and I want to be very direct with you: you are absolutely worthy of being alive.
When things feel this heavy, your mind can start playing tricks on you, convincing you of things that aren't true. Those feelings are real and overwhelming, but they aren’t facts. You have inherent value simply because you exist, and the world is better with you in it, even if you can’t see why right now.
Please reach out to someone who can sit with you in this darkness and help you find a way through. You don’t have to carry this by yourself.Resources Available Right Now (24/7):988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline: Call or text 988 (available in English and Spanish).Crisis Text Line: Text HOME to 741741.The Trevor Project (LGBTQ Youth): Call 1-866-488-7386 or text START to 678-678.International Resources: If you are outside the U.S., please find a local helpline at findahelpline.com.If you are in immediate danger, please call 911 (or your local emergency services) or go to the nearest emergency room.
There is hope, and there is help. Please stay.
